review_method: All frames in chronological down/external contact sheets, plus full trajectory reconstruction; videos retain all three streams.

visual_review.method: Inspected every chronological down/external frame in two contact sheets per episode, alongside full recorded command trajectories.

findings.0: Continuous approach, close, lift, carry, release into bin and retreat; block visible between fingers until release.
findings.4: Same complete sequence in shifted block/bin layout; release and settled block visible, no dropped payload during transport.
findings.8: Reviewed every down/external frame: aligned descent, closed grasp, sustained lift/transport, release into shifted bin, and empty-gripper retreat. No missing frames or lost payload observed.
findings.12: Reviewed every down/external frame: block stays between fingers through lift and transport, releases above the bin at 43.4 s, settles inside, and remains there during retreat.
findings.16: Reviewed every down/external frame in the held-out layout: successful aligned descent, sustained physical grasp/lift/transport, visible release at 43.6-43.8 s into the bin, and retreat with the block remaining in the bin.

visual_review.action_plot: All five complete position and gripper trajectories inspected: decoded markers overlap raw setpoints; closing/opening transitions align with measured aperture changes.
